name: icon-frames
title: Icon Frames
description: Small Tailwind icon containers that give icons contrast and a compact visual home.
useWhen: An icon needs a small visual container before it becomes part of a larger component.
avoidWhen: The icon alone is a clickable control and requires button semantics.
responsiveBehavior: Frames retain their fixed visual size and do not introduce layout behavior.
accessibility: Treat decorative icon frames as hidden from assistive technology.
Use a semantic button around a frame when it triggers an action.

variants.title: Soft icon
variants.description: A gentle tinted icon frame for a feature, category, or low-emphasis utility marker.
accessibility: The surrounding component supplies the accessible label.

variants.title: Outline icon
variants.description: A neutral outlined icon frame that works against light surfaces without demanding attention.
accessibility: The surrounding component supplies the accessible label.
